teamJoined.title: {name} joined your team
teamJoined.titleUnnamed: A new member joined your team
teamJoined.body: They now have access to your store.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password on this account was just changed and other devices were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately.

passwordReset.title: Your password was changed
passwordReset.body: A reset link was used to set a new password, and other devices were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset it again immediately.

passwordSet.title: A password was set on your account
passwordSet.body: This account can now sign in with a password as well as Google. If this wasn't you, reset it immediately.

resetRequested.title: A password reset link was requested
resetRequested.body: Someone asked for a link to set a new password on this account. If it wasn't you, ignore the email and change your password.

emailChangeRequested.title: Email change requested
emailChangeRequested.body: Someone asked to move this account to a new email address. It only takes effect once the link in that inbox is confirmed. If this wasn't you, change your password now.

lockedOut.title: Someone is trying to sign in to your account
lockedOut.body: Your password was entered correctly, followed by too many wrong two-factor codes, so sign-in has been paused for a few minutes. If this wasn't you, your password is known to someone else: change it now.

recoveryCodeUsed.title: A recovery code was used to sign in
recoveryCodeUsed.body: Someone signed in to your account with a recovery code. That turns two-factor authentication off and signs out every other device. If this was you, set up two-factor again in Settings › Security. If it wasn't, change your password now.

twoFactorEnabled.title: Two-factor authentication is on
twoFactorEnabled.body: Signing in to your account now needs your passkey or a code from your authenticator app, and every other device was signed out. If this wasn't you, change your password and contact support.

factorAdded.title: A passkey or authenticator app was added
factorAdded.body: "{name}" can now be used to sign in to your account. If this wasn't you, remove it in Settings › Security and change your password.
factorAdded.bodyUnnamed: "Authenticator app" can now be used to sign in to your account. If this wasn't you, remove it in Settings › Security and change your password.

twoFactorDisabled.title: Two-factor authentication is off
twoFactorDisabled.body: Your last passkey or authenticator app was removed, so signing in now needs only your password. If this wasn't you, change your password and turn two-factor back on.

factorRemoved.title: A passkey or authenticator app was removed
factorRemoved.body: "{name}" can no longer be used to sign in to your account. If this wasn't you, change your password now.

recoveryCodesRegenerated.title: New recovery codes were generated
recoveryCodesRegenerated.body: Your old recovery codes no longer work. If this wasn't you, change your password now.
